phrases.note: Failure: miss của mình, không họ.

example.en: What I missed was the null path in retry.
example.vi: Mình miss nhánh null lúc retry.

phrases.note: Nhận. Không The test didn't catch it as excuse duy nhất.

example.en: I owned the miss — I should have added a test.
example.vi: Mình nhận — lẽ ra phải thêm test.

example.en: The impact was 20 minutes of failed checkouts.

phrases.note: Hành động sau. Một thay đổi.

example.en: What I changed after: a checklist before merge.

example.vi: Lần sau mình page sớm hơn.

pattern.title: Own the miss
pattern.pattern: What I missed was… I owned the miss → The impact was… → What I changed after / Next time I'd…
pattern.explainVi: Failure: miss của mình, nhận, impact, một thay đổi sau. Không đổ QA / không I learned to work harder.

drills.prompt: Nói việc thật hôm nay: What I missed was ___
Nói to, đừng chỉ đọc thầm: Mình nhận miss đó
Nói việc thật hôm nay: The impact was ___
Nói to, đừng chỉ đọc thầm: Sau đó mình đổi…

listen.title: Failure follow-up

unseen.speaker: A
unseen.en: What I missed was a config default in staging vs prod.
unseen.vi: Miss: default config staging khác prod.

unseen.speaker: A
unseen.en: I owned the miss. I copied staging blindly.

unseen.speaker: A
unseen.en: The impact was 12 minutes of empty search.

unseen.speaker: A
unseen.en: What I changed after: prod/staging diffs in the PR template.
unseen.vi: Sau đó: diff prod/staging trong PR template.

unseen.speaker: A
unseen.en: Next time I'd compare configs before merge.
unseen.vi: Lần sau so config trước merge.

listen.methodVi: Ẩn chữ. Nghe 1–2 lần (video hoặc TTS). Làm task. Mới mở transcript. Shadow 3 lượt: nghe → nói theo → nói một mình.

Nói to, đừng chỉ đọc thầm: Mình nhận miss đó

aiPrompt.scenario: A real miss the learner owned. Push for impact numbers and one process change. No blaming QA.
aiPrompt.system: You are a software interviewer at a foreign company. Speak natural interview English. Keep each turn to 1–2 short sentences. You MAY use extra interview English so the learner practices listening. Interrupt with a follow-up. Nudge the learner to use these phrases: What I missed was…; I owned the miss; The impact was…; What I changed after; Next time I'd…. Ask about their real experience. Wait for the learner to reply. Scenario: A real miss the learner owned. Push for impact numbers and one process change. No blaming QA.
